# Development Plan for Project Enhancement (2025-04-15 15:22:17)

_**User**_

continue the development STRICT to the plan @prompt.mdc 

Follow this instructions for the correct integration with the api:


1. **Modify the frontend code**: Instead of calling the PDF extraction API directly from client-side JavaScript, the frontend should call an endpoint on its own server.

2. **Create a proxy endpoint**: Add a new endpoint to the reader application's server that will:
   - Receive the PDF file from the client
   - Forward the request to the PDF extraction API using server-side HTTP calls
   - Return the response to the client

Here's a specific example to share with the developer:

```javascript
// SERVER-SIDE CODE (Node.js/Express example)
const express = require('express');
const axios = require('axios');
const multer = require('multer');
const FormData = require('form-data');

const app = express();
const upload = multer({ storage: multer.memoryStorage() });

// This is the endpoint that the frontend will call
app.post('/proxy/extract-pdf', upload.single('file'), async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('file', req.file.buffer, {
      filename: req.file.originalname,
      contentType: 'application/pdf'
    });
    
    if (req.body.prompt) {
      formData.append('prompt', req.body.prompt);
    }
    
    // Server-side request to the PDF extractor API
    const response = await axios.post('http://localhost:55002/extract-pdf', formData, {
      headers: {
        ...formData.getHeaders(),
        'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.PDF_EXTRACTOR_API_KEY}`
      }
    });
    
    // Forward the response back to the client
    res.json(response.data);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error proxying to PDF extractor:', error.message);
    res.status(error.response?.status || 500).json({
      error: 'Error processing PDF',
      details: error.response?.data || error.message
    });
  }
});
```

This approach eliminates CORS issues because:
1. The browser only makes requests to its own origin (https://reader.dg5.com.br)
2. Server-to-server communication isn't subject to CORS restrictions

The frontend code would then use:

```javascript
// FRONTEND CODE
async function extractPDF(file, prompt) {
  const formData = new FormData();
  formData.append('file', file);
  if (prompt) formData.append('prompt', prompt);
  
  // Call your own server endpoint instead of the PDF extractor directly
  const response = await fetch('/proxy/extract-pdf', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: formData
  });
  
  return await response.json();
}
```

This is the most secure and reliable approach for production use, as it also keeps the API key on the server side rather than exposing it to client-side code.

```diff
+ import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
+ import axios from 'axios';
+ import { FormData } from 'formdata-node';
+ import { fileFromPath } from 'formdata-node/file-from-path';
+ 
+ const API_URL = 'http://localhost:55002';
+ const API_TOKEN = '34a60ac2092446db797901ddb6f223209b524e1c145e7f556343e3bf1d33c266';
+ 
+ export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
+   try {
+     // Parse the incoming multipart form data
+     const formData = await request.formData();
+     const file = formData.get('file') as File;
+     const prompt = formData.get('prompt') as string | null;
+     const useOCR = formData.get('use_ocr') as string | null;
+ 
+     if (!file) {
+       return NextResponse.json(
+         { error: 'No file provided' },
+         { status: 400 }
+       );
+     }
+ 
+     // Create a new FormData object for the API request
+     const apiFormData = new FormData();
+     
+     // Convert the file to a buffer and append it to the form
+     const fileBuffer = Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer());
+     const fileName = file.name || 'document.pdf';
+     
+     // Append the file with the correct content type
+     apiFormData.append('file', new Blob([fileBuffer], { type: file.type }), fileName);
+     
+     // Add optional parameters if they exist
+     if (prompt) {
+       apiFormData.append('prompt', prompt);
+     }
+     
+     if (useOCR) {
+       apiFormData.append('use_ocr', useOCR);
+     }
+ 
+     // Make the request to the PDF Extractor API
+     const response = await axios.post(`${API_URL}/extract-pdf`, apiFormData, {
+       headers: {
+         'Authorization': `Bearer ${API_TOKEN}`,
+         'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data',
+       },
+     });
+ 
+     // Return the API response to the client
+     return NextResponse.json(response.data);
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error('Error proxying to PDF extractor:', error);
+     
+     // Handle errors from the API
+     if (axios.isAxiosError(error) && error.response) {
+       return NextResponse.json(
+         { 
+           error: 'Error processing PDF',
+           details: error.response.data
+         },
+         { status: error.response.status }
+       );
+     }
+     
+     // Handle other errors
+     return NextResponse.json(
+       { 
+         error: 'Error processing PDF',
+         details: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
+       },
+       { status: 500 }
+     );
+   }
+ } 
```
